name: exploratory
description: Read items published on exploratory.io and create data, charts, analytics, and reports in the Exploratory Desktop app on your computer.

ai_summary.title: AI Summary output
ai_summary.description: Whether to create and save an AI Summary for charts and analytics you create

save_comments.title: Save comments
save_comments.description: Whether to save an explanatory comment on charts you create

review_hook.title: Review hook
review_hook.description: false: never review. true: review before the first create, after wrangling, and after chart and analytics create or edit calls.

plan_gate.title: Plan gate
plan_gate.description: true: after an R report (HTML) is saved, block creation in Exploratory until the plan (<title>_Exploratory作成計画.md) is saved (independent of the review hook). false: do nothing.
